workload.description: One hour of events: 24 batches of 4,000 records, each written as JSON, compressed and hashed.

language_or_algorithm.statement: Neither is at fault: pack is three calls into the standard library, and the work of each is done in compiled code already.

decision.reason: The project's own Python is a fraction of a percent of the time. The compression level is the thing to look at, not the language.
